title: Impetigo follow-up

user_facing_items.final_wording: Supports documenting rapid or significant worsening, failure to improve after treatment, alternative-diagnosis concern, serious illness or cellulitis concern, and prior antibiotic exposure.
user_facing_items.population: Adults, children, and young people with impetigo, including reassessment after treatment or recurrent disease.
user_facing_items.setting: Community, primary care, and hospital reassessment of impetigo.
user_facing_items.jurisdiction: United Kingdom; international evidence requiring UAE antimicrobial and referral adaptation
restrictions: Exact for documenting worsening, non-improvement, serious-illness features, previous antimicrobial exposure, microbiology already obtained, result review, and clinician-led referral context. Antibiotic names, doses, durations, and treatment choices are excluded.
user_facing_items.rationale: The exact reassessment section supports an impetigo follow-up record of interval change, current symptoms, distribution, systemic context, serious-illness concern and previous treatment exposure without confirming infection or changing therapy.
